text: <speak version='1.0' xml:lang='zh-HK'><voice name='zh-HK-HiuMaanNeural'><prosody rate='+0%' pitch='+0st'>錢平微微點頭，筆尖在帳冊上勾了一下：</prosody></voice></speak>

text: <speak version='1.0' xml:lang='zh-HK'><voice name='zh-HK-HiuGaaiNeural'><prosody rate='-10%' pitch='-1.5st'>「沒錯，記性不錯。」</prosody></voice></speak>
speaker: 錢平

text: <speak version='1.0' xml:lang='zh-HK'><voice name='zh-HK-HiuGaaiNeural'><prosody rate='-10%' pitch='-1.5st'>「以貌取人會誤事。」</prosody></voice></speak>
speaker: 錢平

text: <speak version='1.0' xml:lang='zh-HK'><voice name='zh-HK-HiuMaanNeural'><prosody rate='+0%' pitch='+0st'>錢平冷冷道，</prosody></voice></speak>
speaker: narrator

text: <speak version='1.0' xml:lang='zh-HK'><voice name='zh-HK-HiuGaaiNeural'><prosody rate='-10%' pitch='-1.5st'>「別人的錯誤不能當作她的證據。」</prosody></voice></speak>
speaker: 錢平

text: <speak version='1.0' xml:lang='zh-HK'><voice name='zh-HK-HiuGaaiNeural'><prosody rate='-10%' pitch='-1.5st'>「阿水不總是對的。」</prosody></voice></speak>
speaker: 錢平

text: <speak version='1.0' xml:lang='zh-HK'><voice name='zh-HK-HiuMaanNeural'><prosody rate='+0%' pitch='+0st'>錢平看了角落一眼，</prosody></voice></speak>
speaker: narrator

text: <speak version='1.0' xml:lang='zh-HK'><voice name='zh-HK-HiuGaaiNeural'><prosody rate='-10%' pitch='-1.5st'>「你要有自己的眼光。」</prosody></voice></speak>
speaker: 錢平

text: <speak version='1.0' xml:lang='zh-HK'><voice name='zh-HK-HiuGaaiNeural'><prosody rate='-10%' pitch='-1.5st'>「沒錯。五十歲的老梁還在學認字。」</prosody></voice></speak>
speaker: 錢平

text: <speak version='1.0' xml:lang='zh-HK'><voice name='zh-HK-HiuMaanNeural'><prosody rate='+0%' pitch='+0st'>錢平嘆道，</prosody></voice></speak>
speaker: narrator

text: <speak version='1.0' xml:lang='zh-HK'><voice name='zh-HK-HiuGaaiNeural'><prosody rate='-10%' pitch='-1.5st'>「你呢？」</prosody></voice></speak>
speaker: 錢平

text: <speak version='1.0' xml:lang='zh-HK'><voice name='zh-HK-HiuGaaiNeural'><prosody rate='-10%' pitch='-1.5st'>「他出了謎語，你忘了嗎？他在引導你。」</prosody></voice></speak>
speaker: 錢平
